label: 按用户文件映射整理 BIDS（文件名检查）
description: Copy files according to an explicit source-relative to BIDS-relative JSON mapping, check destination filenames with BIDSValidator, and write dataset metadata and a staging report. It does not infer missing entities or perform full dataset validation。 Inputs: input: 源数据集目录 (directory); mapping: 显式文件映射 JSON（源相对路径 → BIDS 相对路径） (file). Registered outputs: results/dataset_description.json, results/staging_report.json. Fixed invocation options: --operation stage.
